notes.title: AMF FULL RELEASE 1.00 w/ NEW WEAPONS & SURVIVAL CAMPAIGN MODE
notes.content:
Hi All,

We are pleased to announce the full release of ALPHA MIKE FOXTROT VR today, we thank everyone for their feedback and reviews for helping us to get this far. It has been a wonderful journey with you all!

For today's full release we will be offering a limited time launch discount starting at 9AM PST. If you or your friends are looking to pickup AMF VR, now would be a great time!

With 1.00 release of the game we will be providing 3 new weapons, a new map (Wasteland) and a brand new Survival Campaign mode!

PLEASE RELOAD STEAM AND DOWNLOAD THE LATEST AMF UPDATE BEFORE PLAYING:

New Weapons:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/d44cbb116546ad3456a484a0f4bb2a26607d84d8.jpg

 Desert Eagle
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/8a68be683a2c2a6713622c940e020c45a7b7ef1c.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/aa3fbde23c46769f9c5ec113cb7d2ec74da1fa5b.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/151c221a7255dc8d84251de2aca3a80e49322dcf.gif
Our latest pistol the Desert Eagle, provides higher damage per shot, with a trade-off of higher recoil and a smaller magazine.  The pistol will be available for selection upon death in the weapons selection menu or picked up in the Wasteland during survival mode

 Katana
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/e792935a9ca7aeafe46f902d3c4996872a2a206d.gif
Due to popular demand, we added the much wanted Katana blade. The Katana is located behind your back. Reach over either shoulder to bring it out! You may slash and stab the enemy or dual wield it while holding the combat knife as well. Use two handed grip for added stability!

 Pump Action Shotgun
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/f94da184085286c7e215bd5017bb7a4d3197cb8a.gif
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/004d1ab70a97b623204b7d1ae1603022b9ed0bf3.gif
The Shotgun adds a new dynamic to AMF VR and is very useful for room clearing and spread shots. You may select it in the starting room or weapons menu when you die. Pump each time you shoot by using your off hand on the front grip and holding down the trigger while pulling back. Reloading is done by loading the shells in one at a time, with a maximum of 8 shots. Lock n load! 
 

NEW MAP: Wasteland
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/49c654e107c6df228f1d772bc88e7835e3f73728.jpg
Wasteland is a larger sized Post-Apocalyptic map with many buildings and uneven terrain for you to mix up your combat style in. The map can be played in Deathmatch, Team Deathmatch as well as our newest campaign mode: Survival. Come check it out today! 

NEW CAMPAIGN: SURVIVAL
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/434e6fedd8a49bee0d0f76ed3a461d40e274b613.jpg
Survival is our newest Campaign mode for AMF VR and may have up to a team of 4 playing at the same time. The rules are simple:
You have one life
Survive for 10 minutes and scour for weapons on the battlefield
Make it to the rescue helicopter. The chopper will appear once the 10 minutes is up. Be aware that it will appear at a random location each time.

Survival Mode Guide
Welcome to the Wasteland
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/e0759ac0f01b2c0a76dcf94921f3e26f37337559.jpg

The Survival Campaign may be selected from the host menu in the lobby
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/f7dd7296d3f261e7e64a7f412562b500615ef0c3.jpg

Once you enter the Wasteland, remember to press START once you are ready or when all your teammates have arrived. You may check the mission guidelines by pressing your watch on your left hand:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/79c3bc270707804a37f390254c6311a1a462c49a.jpg

Starting out, you will have a Pistol, Katana and Combat Knife. Scour the landscape to find additional weapons. Be sure to conserve your ammo as it is limited and specific to each weapon acquired
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/2a73e8c6cb06c3dcae66909481871f333d476605.jpg

Killing enemies also allows you to pick up their weapon:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/2d9a6989e22a5e068813d0e96c958c1c9ed1ec28.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/39a59dce822cb6a16d33b87d19ae789e9719b0c8.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/a6a4f34f7d83de9b868406510f3694e8c82a7db7.jpg

You may revive your teammates if they are down by standing in the white circle for 5 seconds. If all members of your team die, the game is over
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/c005231d9242e06064c0b2d352569bfc61a75e74.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/0b271575f885071165baa123de5b3300090b2bae.jpg

Survive for 10 minutes and wait for the helicopter to arrive. Make your approach carefully for a successful extraction. Only one member needs to reach the helicopter to complete the mission.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/c6d59ee5bf847b6c72643c0ba135860c01c93006.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/40154b4017e16a72ca7e5d0c7b040451768b6b9f.jpghttps://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/bd7fbd9cace68d585780f2cf927087d50a0ddf52.jpg

Congratulations, you have completed the Survival Campaign!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/a3b7deabeda4944da5c6d31d8da22bb0ba2cf62a.jpg


We hope you enjoy our latest update and make it to the top of the leaderboards!

Stay up to date with the latest news, communicate with the AMF community and be part of the VR FPS revolution by joining our Discord: 
https://discordapp.com/invite/5mdwNsD

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/506a591d354b981ece5f178ddd4fc83429bacd14.png

notes.content:
We have a weekend hotfix for everyone: 

PLEASE RELOAD STEAM AND DOWNLOAD THE LATEST AMF UPDATE BEFORE PLAYING:

Fixed the double kill count error in Campaign Mode

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE #3 - Co-op Campaign Mode: Operation Frontal Assault + Add Friends Ingame + Private Games
notes.content:
Hi All,

Merry Christmas!!  The AMF Team has been hard at work these few weeks to bring you an all NEW GAME MODE and major feature updates

PLEASE RELOAD STEAM & DOWNLOAD THE LATEST AMF VR UPDATE BEFORE PLAYING Ver 0.80

OPERATION: FRONTAL ASSAULT
Welcome to our first Co-op Campaign Mission it is suggested to have at least 2 players to complete it, with a maximum of 4. Select the "Enclave" Map to start the challenge. Operation: Frontal Assault features a massive map needing to complete 3 objectives. Your team has 30 lives to complete the Campaign, here is your mission guide:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/bbb8b83e2f7a950d49fdae53630b7fa4222af867.jpg

START
You will start on a boat, please invite team members here or wait for players to join before pressing START. You may also go solo and invite players to join mid game. You may go Solo, but it will be extremely challenging.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/882ab19e39b57700e493b7686ea9bb7a40800f37.jpg

OBJECTIVE A: Find the Code, Open the Gate
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/07483d98dec0e697a198e9220b389c3bcae1e702.jpg
The code is in any 1 of the 4 container houses located on the edges of the map. Check your mission guide using the panel on your left hand for the locations.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/5a9b01437d96aad7fd0a31e287e5f41826103e1b.jpg
Search the table for the code, it could be hidden under an item:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/545215d21756181ce8ce32deb45b501403dbe45a.jpg
Make it to the gate and enter the code to get to the next stage, don't forget to pickup the shield before moving on!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/03528ec9e16be63ceb441ab04714f8ff95c0068d.jpg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/6504a2b972e954f4b92d1c4fa44642ebcea7ea79.jpg
OBJECTIVE A Hint: Clear out all the towers using the sniper rifle before proceeding to search for the code
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/c8a0d38ef1e82c3038fc7b222887e00250c305f0.jpg

OBJECTIVE B: Capture 3 checkpoints
Fight your way down the highway and capture 3 checkpoints along the way. Be careful and always watch your back!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/a6495ca55f5781d621d95db494cc6126b548756e.jpg
When Standing in the circle you will capture each check point. There are a total of 3.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/17c2e943fdab882ad4fa087c1e1c74209a768ef2.jpg
OBJECTIVE B Hint: At Checkpoint 1, you have an opportunity to reload your grenades and knifes once the point is captured.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/1da323219d728583cbe9b8d01bd9ae8c7c70b3b8.jpg

OBJECTIVE C: Escort the Tank to the Airstrip and Escape! BEWARE: BOSS BOTS!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/06278fa4d32265b005cf3ef3e3880bd19b494364.jpg
This massive base is split into two sections. Fight your way through the enemy's main military complex and reach the tank located in the industrial section of the map.  You may look at your left hand for an arrow pointing towards where the tank is parked. (The tank is parked under the sky bridge).
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/5a85c56ae7bfd4cd515cebfdf2452ce061f4de70.jpg
Stand within the Yellow Circle and escort the tank to the airstrip. As long as you are in the Yellow Circle the tank will move towards its destination automatically.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/aa9dadf5268b9697bc6881cead0343b398a6a931.jpg
Upon reaching the last part of the Escort mission, your rescue helicopter will fly towards the airstrip. Make sure the tank destroys the last gate in order to make it to safety!
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/924e95b03e1554816d2b07890ea70cad6ef738fd.jpg
OBJECTIVE C Hint: When trying to reach the tank, run round the edge of the map, use cover to avoid enemy detection. Either breach the main entrance on the left of go over the sky bridge on the right.

Challenge the leaderboard for the best completion time. 
GOOD LUCK!! :D
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/8da5e686a26fe946fd5f0412cedd7b3a9e5b61ae.jpg


OTHER BIG UPDATES:
Framework
Added function to add friends on Steam directly from the Scoreboard. When playing, open the scoreboard and there will be a man icon next to their name. If it is White: They are your friend, Green with + symbol, you may click on it to invite them to be your steam friend! 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/922c31d21f18f9e4072165eacadc2258aa973ff7.png
If someone sends you a friend invite you will see a man icon pop up in your menu system, click on it and accept the invite to be friends :)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/dcaf7fd7708086f3b8cf1f22288965db203526c0.png
Brand new friends menu in the lobby and in game. See which of your friends are in game, and on which server
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/3335d336f36a0f7b606f681431767295f60f3111.png
Added function to invite friends to join your game, open your menu system in game and press the "3 heads" button to open the friends menu.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/63d879a02bf1a4dd6f59335f9e63b16dc5a0d6f9.png
 From here you can invite a friend to join a game. 
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/9b8c4cfc773b943f48c50d87dc9088e1ded32e85.png
If you friend is in the lobby, he will see a door next to your name and room number on the friends list. Click the door and enter the game.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/d55082846664ff7afa978832d5e599702fb4959f.png
Added function to lock you game for single player which includes invite friends only when locked. This can be done in the lobby or in game.
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/70712d03f68c4cdea859d196459a86fad327180d.png
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/77df4de5be1c78967c45199b531ae8f2ae85d8dc.jpg
Brand new weapons selection menu using gaze and trigger
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/13d4df2cfb7125cdd917eef28693126373f73324.png

Hope Everyone has a Merry Christmas and enjoy the new game mode and features!

Need Teammates for Operation Frontal Assault? Stay up to date with the latest news, communicate with the AMF community and be part of the VR FPS revolution by joining our Discord: 
https://discordapp.com/invite/5mdwNsD

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/717f947e3c451704f6701b96554a25693c37e4d5.jpg

notes.title: EARLY ACCESS UPDATE #1 - KILL STREAKS & Other fixes (HOTFIX 4)
notes.content:
Hi All,

PLEASE RELOAD STEAM & DOWNLOAD THE LATEST AMF VR UPDATE BEFORE PLAYING

We are pleased to announce the latest update to AMF VR with UPDATE #1. The updates are separate from Hotfixes and will be labeled accordingly.

Update #1
 Improved Starting Screen graphics and planted some grass ːsteamhappyː:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/9f61aafafbece223b1607078dfd26f2bf79738ad.gif

 AMF Now includes Kill Steaks for added excitement and achievement, both audio and visual queues will now be seen and heard! These effects are client side and can only be seen by the player.  You may turn of the audio Kill Streaks on / off in the lobby menu:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/aa3e5a4cc4b326b7cd326d51818c66c096e46d5c.jpg

Users will now be rewarded with the following Kill Streaks:
First Blood: First Kill made once game starts
Headshot: Every time a headshot is made
Double Kill: 2 kills within 10 secs
Triple Kill: 3 kills, within 10 seconds of previous kill
Multi Kill-->Mega Kill-->Ultra Kill: 4,5,6 kills, within 10 seconds of previous kill
Killing Spree: 3 kills without Dying
Rampage: 5 kills without Dying
Unstoppable: 10 kills without Dying
Massacre: ???? Find out in game :)
Invincible: ???? Find out in game :)
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/f99cd5840730f9dc61ed278e1bab2872efe39771.jpg
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/421a53e40eadf94e1456206c93477fcea85d968c.jpg

Your Kill Streak count will be visible on screen in the top right corner of the screen, the lightning increases as you level up your Kill Streak:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/06aa723c7f6127588aac406e31229bbc18177478.jpg

=====================================
EA HOTFIX 4:
Cleaned up in game menu and removed all wording. To start the game, simply point at the new START button using TRIGGER located under the total number of people in your server:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/5a173e8b893ff9d16b97f7eb1e42ad89240d7a3f.gif
 Added bots / no bots icon to map selection screen to clarify that bots are only available in Classic mode gameplay (at the moment), bots appear once you press start, the host may choose to turn them on and off in the in game control menu:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/1b8f9bdcb2fe439ff63bacdc6a46e5a7ffd17963.gif
 In game Globe Menu location is now persistent and saved permanently after moving. To move location simply point at the globe, to reset location hold down trigger and press the menu (Y or B) button to reset.
 Further improvement to set height accuracy. Set height is extremely important, to make sure that your height is correct, please place both controllers on the floor in game and make sure they are properly resting on the in game floor.  If they are floating or beneath floor, please check your Oculus / Vive Room Scale Settings are correct

======================================

Preview of upcoming updates on the way (Yes, we have been listening to all your feedback!): 
 Continue from Victory Room to play next map (Host Controlled)
 Lockable Private Servers to play alone against bots or with friends
 Co-op mode, kill bots together with friends
 Boss Bots
 New Game Modes, Maps and Guns!
 Much Much more, stay tuned!

Thanks for playing, and hope you are enjoying our progress on the updates and hope to see you all in game!

https://discordapp.com/invite/5mdwNsD

notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30468900/e227352a53359d27d2466ea4b9dbe5ac789bea5c.jpg
These are the current fixes and updates for upcoming BETA Weekend 6, we are still working on some additions:

New Feature:
Added AI Bots (Version 0.10) - Due to popular demand through the survey results, bots was the top requested feature you wanted included in AMF, so here you go!  
The team has worked hard this week and pleased to deliver the brand new Bots playmode as promised (Early Version). Please note this is nowhere near finished and just the beginning! :) 

How to start a BOT game:
1) Start a game using the “Classic” (All Weapons) Game play mode with 2, 4, 6 or 8 players either TDM or DM
2) Bots will spawn accordingly once the game starts by pulling both triggers with the menu open. Players are still free to chat and wait for other players without the bots before then.
3) If a new player hops into the server, one of the bots will be replaced. 

Current limitations: 
Bots are currently available on ALL maps except for Dock, Ruins and Dugouts. 
Bots are currently available in Classic mode only (not available for Pistol / Knife / Knife only modes)
Bots’ kill score will not show on the Scoreboard, only players’ scores will show
The difficulty level is set to “Standard”, different levels will be coming soon.
Look forward to more bot features as we continue to make the game better!

Framework:
Further increased network stability for login and reduced chance of dropout during games
Fixed Respawning issue in Prison and Dock maps
Blood Effects Increased
Fixed some movement animations 

Enjoy!

notes.title: ALPHA MIKE FOXTROT Pre-Early Access Beta Testing is open for Application!
notes.content:
Hi Guys!
 
We’ve got some good news and bad news to share with everybody. 
 
Bad News :(
 
Our team has decided to push back our Early Access release date to October 20th. The main reason is to verify the robustness of our game servers under heavy load while giving us time to further increase the performance of our game based on early feedback. The added time also allows us to insert some of the unique play styles of AMF that were originally intended to be added post-Early Access. Thank you for your patience. 
 
We believe in crafting a highly playable experience immediately available for Early Access, so that we can focus on creating new content for AMF instead of still having to fix major bugs constantly. We hope that by doing so, it will give us the opportunity to first communicate with you all and work towards building a dedicated following that shares the love of AMF.
 
Good News :)
 
We are opening up three straight weekends of Beta Testing for you guys to get a taste of AMF in some intense online multiplayer action. The intention is for you guys to help us break the server. :) 
 
With an extra month for us to fine-tune the game, it allows us to get more players like yourself involved in helping with testing and feedback. Sign up now to try before you buy and help us steer AMF into the right direction.
